rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL regular expression in createErrorFormatter
rawFindings.explanation: The URL_REGEXP was changed from '(?:http:\/\/[^\/]*)?\/?...' to 'http:\/\/[^\/]*\/' which makes the protocol and domain mandatory and no longer optional. This breaks the ability to format relative URLs (like '/base/b.js:2:6') that do not include the protocol domain prefix, reducing the robustness of error formatting.
rawFindings.suggestion:
Restore the original URL_REGEXP that makes the protocol and domain optional, i.e., revert line 24 to:
var URL_REGEXP = new RegExp('(?:http:\/\/[^\/]*)?\/?' +
  '(base|absolute)' +  // prefix

rawFindings.title: Regular expression for URL matching restricts accepted URLs incorrectly
rawFindings.explanation: The original regular expression in line 24 matched URLs optionally starting with domain and accepted both '/base' and '/absolute' prefixes. The changed version only matches URLs starting with 'http://' (not optional), then a non-empty domain (no slash), then a slash, and then a path starting without optional leading slash. This removes support for protocol-relative URLs, explicit relative URLs and implicit URLs used in error messages like '/base/file.js'. This will break stack trace rewriting fo
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the regular expression on line 24 to its original form that optionally matches the domain and leading slash, i.e., revert to: var URL_REGEXP = new RegExp('(?:http:\/\/[^\/]*)?\/?' + '(base|absolute)' + '((?:[A-z]\:)?[^\?\s\:]*)' + '(\?\w*)?' + '(\:(\d+))?' + '(\:(\d+))?', 'g')

rawFindings.title: Incorrect regular expression for URL matching in error formatter
rawFindings.explanation: The change modifies URL_REGEXP from a regex that optionally matches the domain part (including zero or one leading slash) to a regex that requires the domain part and a trailing slash. This breaks matching of paths without protocol + domain (e.g., '/base/file.js'), which were previously matched but are no longer matched after the change. This could cause source URL rewriting to fail for relative URLs.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the regex change on line 24 to the original version to support matching URL prefixes with or without the domain and optional slashes, preserving prior behavior.
